title.narrative: Growth, Investment and the Low Carbon Transition: Constructing a Climate-Resilient Future for the G-20

description.narrative: The objective of this study was to present a compelling analysis of how sustainable, low-emissions and climate-resilient development can be achieved to minimise long-run structural adjustment costs without compromising economic growth, competitiveness, development and well-being. The study spelled out the implications of the climate goals agreed in Paris at COP21 for investments in physical infrastructure and a range of other issues (e.g. technology and land-use), and what could be done to ensure that policy and other choices yield the economic, social and environmental benefits desired by G20 countries consistent with containing climatic risks and enhancing resilience.
